Honors at URI is a specialized academic program designed for a diverse community of engaged learners and intellectually curious students. It offers small, discussion-based classes that foster deeper exploration, broader perspectives, and more complex discussions. The program provides a supportive environment for academic growth, interdisciplinary learning, meaningful collaboration, and connections between students, their peers and faculty.
